So rule 26's fallback applies: paginate and count unique product cards. The storefront's own API was located by reading assets.sostrenegrene.com/client/dist/assets/main-DuYavdwi.js: the PLP component SearchProductControl calls Do.get('/catalog/search', {categoryId, roomId, sortBy, term, page, pageSize, ...facets}) and Do.getUrl() prefixes '/umbraco/api/', with header culture: da-DK; CategoryDetailsPage passes page-size 48. The categoryId is the INTERNAL numeric id from pageData.jsonContent.content.categoryId (1210 for Badeværelsestilbehør), NOT the 8332 in the URL slug - passing 8332 returns total 0 / isEmpty true, which is the trap that would have produced a false EMPTY NODE. COUNT TRAPS FOUND AND REJECTED ON THIS SITE: (1) the API's own 'total' field is NOT reliable. For categoryId=1210 it read 45 on repeated calls but 55 on one earlier call in the same session; for categoryId=83 it read 31 at one moment and 26 twenty minutes later while the item set was unchanged at 31. It is an eventually-consistent index counter and was rejected. (2) The API's facet block is also inconsistent with its own payload: for categoryId=1210 the categoryIds facet reports 45 for key '1210' and the inStock facet sums to 45, while all 55 returned items carry '1210' in their categoryIds array. (3) Page-by-page enumeration is page-size dependent because the server slices the index and then post-filters, losing items at page boundaries: the same category enumerates to 49 unique at pageSize=8, 50 at pageSize=28, 53 at pageSize=48 (48+5) and 55 in a single request at pageSize>=55. VERIFICATION (how 55 was proved): the count recorded is an EXHAUSTIVE SINGLE-REQUEST ENUMERATION - page=1 with pageSize large enough that the whole category returns in one response, so no page-boundary filtering can occur. Proof of exhaustion: at pageSize 55, 60, 100, 200, 300 and 500 the response returns the SAME 55 unique type-1 (ProductSimple) product ids, and requesting page=2 at pageSize>=55 returns zero items. Proof of determinism: the request was repeated under five different sort orders (default, sortBy=score, name, priceAsc, newest) at pageSize=300 and the returned id sets are identical - symmetric difference 0 in all five comparisons - so the 55 is the complete category membership and not a relevance-ranked truncation. The six repeat calls at pageSize=8 and pageSize=100 run back to back also returned a stable set. Content check: the 55 product names are unambiguously bathroom (Toiletbørste, Tandbørstekrus x3, Sæbedispenser x5, Sæbeskål x5, Pedalspand, Badeværelseshylde med holder, Håndklædering, Bademåtte, Vægkrog/Krog/Knage/Knagerække/Skalkrog, Stabelbar opbevaringskurv x3, Spejl, Opbevaringsmøbel x3), which matches H1/navigationTitle 'Badeværelsestilbehør' and breadcrumb Produkter > Bolig > Interiør > Badeværelsestilbehør.
